name: G6 T3 W10 - Button counters
description: Study these five words across this week. Complete Flashcards, Matching and Fill in Blank once. Then choose additional practice. Reuse this pool throughout the week. Follow your separate class instructions.

words.definition: Information or a signal given to a computer or program.
words.example: Pressing button A provides an input to the program.

words.definition: Information or a signal produced by a computer or program.
words.example: The displayed number is an output from the counter.

words.definition: A named place in a program that stores a value which can change.
words.example: The variable count stores the number of button presses.

words.definition: A control that you press or select to make something happen.
words.example: Press the button to add one to the counter.

words.definition: A value or device used to keep track of how many times something happens.
words.example: The counter increases by one after each button press.
